steps.say: The scan shows open space about 3.5 m to my left, while walls are close in front and to the right. I'll turn left to face that open area.
The scan shows open space straight ahead (about 3.5 m) and to the left (about 4 m), with walls close on the right. I'll drive forward 2 m.
The scan shows the nearest walls ahead-left (about 0.25 m) and right (about 0.2 m), while the area behind me is clearer, about 3 m. I'll turn around to face that direction.

The scan shows open space about 3 m straight ahead, between a wall on the left about 0.2 m away and one on the right about 0.25 m away. The gap is roughly 0.7 m wide, enough for the robot, so I'll drive forward 1.5 m.
The area behind me looks open, about 3 m, while the walls to my right are close. I'll back up 1 m and rescan.
The scan shows no open-space reading (>8) yet, so the exit is still unseen. The clearest direction is ahead, with about 2.4 m of clearance, so I'll drive forward 1.5 m and rescan.
The scan shows walls about 1 m ahead and to the left, with open space about 4 m to my right. I'll turn right to face that opening.
The scan shows about 4 m of clear space straight ahead and to the front-right, with walls close on the left. I'll drive forward 2 m and rescan.
The scan shows about 3.5 m of clear space straight ahead, with walls close on the right and left-front. I'll drive forward 2 m.

The front-right is blocked, since both bumps read zero distance there. The open directions are ahead-left (about 2.6 m at 30°) and straight ahead. I'll turn left about 35° to move away from the right-side obstacle.
The open space is now at about 305° to 340° on my right-front, roughly 3.6 m away, while the wall ahead and left is closer. I'll turn right about 30° to face it.
The forward direction now shows about 3.4 m of clear space, with open space at 335–355° too, and the right-side wall is close. I'll drive forward 2 m and rescan.

The front is clear for about 3.5 m, but there are obstacles touching my right side, which is why the last two forward moves bumped. I'll turn left about 20° to move away from that side, then check the scan.
The front is clear for about 3.35 m, and the walls at my right side are behind me in angle. I'll drive forward 1.5 m and rescan.
The front-right side is blocked at close range, so forward moves keep bumping. The open space is at about 225–240°, behind-left. I'll turn right 130° to face that opening.
The scan shows about 3.6 m of clear space straight ahead, with walls closer at the front-left and rear. I'll drive forward 1.5 m.
The front-left wall is touching my body, which is why the forward moves bumped. The open space is toward the right-front, at about 320° to 330°, so I'll turn right 40° and then move forward.
The open space is now about 3.7 m away at 35–50° to my front-left, and the walls I bumped into are on my right. I'll turn left 40° to face that opening.

The scan shows a wall pressing against my front-left, which is why the forward moves kept bumping. The front-right is about 1.8 to 2.3 m clear, so I'll turn right 45° to move away from that wall before driving.
The scan shows a gap about 40° to 55° to my front-left, with walls close on the left and at 35° and 60°. I'll turn left about 47° to face that gap, then check it.
The scan shows about 3.5 m of clear space straight ahead and to the front-left, with walls close on the right. I'll drive forward 1.5 m and rescan.
The forward path is blocked on the front-right, where readings touch zero, but the left side (about 3.6 m clear) is open. I'll turn left 90° to face that opening.
The scan shows about 3.7 m clear straight ahead and no sign of the exit yet, so I'll drive forward 1.5 m and rescan.
The front-left is open out to about 3.5 m, but the right side is touching a wall, which is why forward moves keep bumping. I'll turn left 30° to pull away from that right-side wall before driving.
The front and left-front look clear for about 3.5 m, but the right side is touching walls. I'll make a short 1 m forward move and rescan before committing further.
The front-right is touching a wall, which is why forward moves keep bumping. I'll back up about 1 m to clear it, then rescan.
The scan shows about 4.5 m of clear space straight ahead, and the walls that caused the earlier bumps are now off to the side. I'll drive forward 1.5 m and rescan.
The front is open for about 3.5 m, but the right side reads zero and my last forward move bumped after 1 m. I'll try a short 0.5 m step to test whether the way ahead is really clear.
The robot is still pinned against a wall on its right-front, and forward moves keep bumping. I'll turn left 90° to get away from that wall and check the new scan.
The right side has about 3.5 m of clear space, the front is blocked at about 1 m, and the rear is close. I'll turn right 90° to face the open side.
The area ahead and to my front-right keeps blocking me. The clearest open space is about 3.5 m away at roughly 240° on my left-rear, so I'll turn right 120° to face it.
The scan shows about 3.5 m clear straight ahead, with walls close on the front-left and right-front. I'll drive forward 1.5 m and rescan.
The front-left is walled off at close range, but the 85° to 125° sector on my left reads about 3.5 m clear. I'll turn left 90° to face that opening and try a short move.
The right-front is pressed against a wall, which explains the repeated zero-distance bumps. I'll turn left 30° to clear it, then try a short move.
The front-right is pressed against a wall and forward moves keep bumping, so I'll back up about 1 m to get clear of it and rescan.
The forward path reads about 4.6 m clear now, but earlier forward moves from a similar spot bumped after 1 m. I'll try a short 1 m step to test it.
The front is open for about 3.5 m, but there is a wall touching my front-right at about 320°. I'll turn left 25° to clear it before driving forward.
The open space is now off to my front-right, around 300° to 340°, about 3.5 m away. I'll turn right about 35° to face it before driving.
The front is now clear for about 3.5 m, and the obstacles are on the right side, so I'll drive forward 1.5 m and rescan.
The right-front is touching a wall, and every forward move has bumped there. The open space is ahead and front-left, so I'll turn left 40° to clear the corner before driving.
The scan shows walls on my right and in front, but open space about 3.6 m away at roughly 205° to 220° behind-left. I'll turn right 150° to face that direction.
The scan shows a wall touching my front-left, but open space about 3.5 m out to the left around 100°. I'll turn about 100° left to face that opening, away from the wall.
The front is clear for about 3.5 m, though the right-front is touching a wall. I'll try a 1 m step straight ahead.

The front reads about 3.5 m clear, but the right-front is touching a wall, which is why every forward move bumps. I'll turn left about 15° to pull the right-front obstacle out of my forward path, then try a 1 m step.
The front-right is still touching walls at 305° to 325°, so I'll turn a bit further left to clear that corner before trying a short step.
The forward and right sides keep bumping into walls, but the rear-left (about 215–230°) reads a clear 3.5 m or more. I'll turn left 140° so that direction faces forward.
The scan shows open space about 3.5 m out to my left (75° to 90°), while walls are close at my rear-left. I'll turn left about 75° to face that opening.
The front is clear for about 3.5 m, and the left-side wall is touching at 70–85°, so I'll try a 1 m step straight ahead.
The left-front is pinned against walls at close range, while the right side and front-right read about 2 m clear. I'll turn right 30° to pull away from the left-front wall, then rescan.
The scan is open at about 30° to 45° on my front-left, at roughly 3.6 m, and the forward readings are blocked at close range on the right. I'll turn left 35° to face that opening.
The front reads about 3.5 m clear, though the front-left at 30° is close, so I'll try a 1 m step straight ahead.
The front-left is walled off at close range, and my forward moves keep bumping. The clearest open space is about 2 m away at roughly 320°, so I'll turn right 40° to face it.
The scan shows open space about 3.5 m away at 35° to 50° to my front-left, and that opening has been my target before. I'll turn left 40° to face it squarely, then try a short move.
The front is clear for about 3.5 m, but several earlier forward moves bumped from similar readings. I'll try a short 0.5 m step to test it.
The front-left corner and a wall touching my left side keep blocking forward moves. Open space is about 1.9 m to my right, so I'll turn right 90° and check the scan.
The rear (about 175° to 205°) shows about 3.5 m of clear space, and the front is blocked at 1.9 m. I'll back up 1 m and rescan.
The scan shows about 3.6 m of clear space to my left, while the front is about 1.9 m and the right side is walled. I'll turn left 90° to face that opening and check the new scan before moving.
The scan shows a wide open area at about 85° to 125° on my left, roughly 3.5 m deep, while the walls at the front-left and right are close. I'll turn left 90° to face that opening.
The front is open for about 3.5 m, but the right-front reads zero, which has caused every bump so far. I'll turn 20° left to pull away from that right-side obstacle, then try a forward move.

The scan shows about 3.5 m clear straight ahead, but every forward move from this spot has bumped, probably because the right side is touching a wall. I'll back up about 1 m to get clear of that right-side contact, then rescan.
The scan now shows about 4.5 m clear straight ahead, which is more than I've seen in any recent forward direction, so I'll try a 1.5 m move.

The forward path keeps bumping on something at my front-right, and I've been turning back and forth in a tight spot. The rear has about 1.8 m clear, so I'll back up 1 m to get room to maneuver and rescan.
The front reads about 4.5 m clear now, so I'll try a 1 m step forward and check the scan.
The front now reads about 3.5 m clear, and my last 1 m forward step succeeded. I'll try another 1.5 m forward and rescan.
The front-right still reads zero, which is why forward moves keep bumping. Turning left about 30° should swing that obstacle out of my forward path, so I'll turn and then probe forward.
The scan shows open space about 3.5 m away at roughly 310° to 345°, to my front-right. The straight-ahead reading is only 2.05 m, so I'll turn right 35° to face that opening and then probe forward.

The right-front is still touching a wall, which has blocked every forward move from this spot. The front-left is open about 3.5 m, so I'll turn 20° left to clear the right-front contact before driving again.
The front reads about 3.6 m clear now, though the right side is still close. I'll try a 1 m step forward.
Forward and front-right are blocked at close range, and the open space is behind-right (about 230°, 3.5 m+). I'll turn right to face that opening, then back out along it.
The front reads zero, but the left side from about 15° to 50° is clear for roughly 3.5 m. I'll turn left about 35° to face that opening.
The scan shows about 3.5 m clear straight ahead, with walls close on both sides. I'll try a short 0.5 m step forward to see whether this corridor is passable.
The forward scan reads about 3.5 m, but my last several forward moves bumped at zero distance. I'll test a very short step to see whether anything is actually touching me.

The forward moves keep bumping on something touching my front-right at about 315–330°, even though the far forward reading is about 3.5 m. Turning left about 60° should swing that contact out of my forward path, and the ray near 55–60° reads about 1.2 m clear.
I'm stuck in a loop of bumps. The rear has about 1.8 m clear and the right side touches a wall, so I'll back up 1 m and rescan.

Right now the nearest walls are on my right side (about 0.5 m at 280° to 330°), while the front is about 2.1 m clear and the front-left opens to about 2.3 m. I'll turn 30° left to steer away from the right-side wall, then probe forward.
The front has about 1.9 m clear and the left-front reads about 2.3 m, so I'll step forward 1 m and rescan.
The scan now shows about 4 m of clear space directly to my right (255° to 285°), which is the first open direction in a while. I'll turn right to face it.
The scan now shows about 4 m clear straight ahead, the first open forward reading in a while. I'll drive forward 1.5 m and check.
The last scan shows a ray at 315° reading ">8", which is open space beyond the house. I'll turn right 45° to face it, then check the scan before driving.
The latest scan shows a ray straight ahead reading >8, which is open space beyond the house. I'll drive forward toward it.
The scan shows open space (>8) straight ahead at 355°, 0°, 5° and 10°, so I'll drive forward 1 m and check again.
The scan shows open space (>8) straight ahead at 355° to 10°, but I bumped there twice from the right-front contact. I'll turn 15° left to get away from that contact, then try a short move.
The exit opening (>8) is now at about 340° to 355°, just right of straight ahead, and a wall sits about 1.2 m ahead. I'll turn 20° right to point at the opening, then check the scan before driving.

The scan shows open space (>8) straight ahead at 0° to 15°, while a wall touches my front-right at about 325° to 335°. That contact is what caused the earlier bumps. I'll turn 15° left to move the contact out of my forward path and keep the exit ahead.
The opening (>8) is now at about 345° to 0°, slightly to my right, and the wall at 5° is about 1.3 m away. I'll turn about 10° right to point straight at the gap.
The exit ray reads >8 at 355° through 10°, and the nearest wall is about 1.3 m off at 15°. I'll drive forward 1 m and check the scan.
The exit ray reads >8 at 355° to 10°, but my last forward move bumped at zero distance, so I'll test a short 0.3 m step to see whether anything is actually touching me.
The exit ray (>8) is straight ahead, but the right-front contact at about 330° keeps stopping me. I'll turn 10° left to clear that contact, then try to drive forward through the gap.
The open exit reading sits at about 345° to 0°, slightly to my right, so I'll turn 10° right to centre on it and then try a short step.
The exit ray reads >8 straight ahead, but a close obstacle at about 320-330° keeps stopping me. I'll turn left 90°, sidestep about 0.4 m to clear it, then turn back toward the exit.
The exit opening (>8 m) now sits at about 265° to 280°, which is my right. I'll turn right 90° to face it.
The exit ray (>8) is now straight ahead at 355° through 10°, with walls about 1.2 m off on the left-front. I'll drive forward 1 m and check.
The exit ray reads >8 straight ahead, but the front-right is touching a wall at about 330°. I'll turn 10° left to clear that contact, then try a short move.
The exit ray reads >8 straight ahead, but a corner at about 320° touches my front-right and has blocked every forward move. I'll turn left 60° to clear that corner before driving.
The exit opening (>8 m) is now at about 285° to 300°, to my front-right. I'll turn right about 65° to face it.
The exit reads >8 straight ahead, but the right-front wall keeps stopping my forward moves. I'll shift my heading slightly right, toward the gap, before trying a short step.

The exit ray reads >8 straight ahead, but my right side is touching a wall at about 320° to 330°, which is why forward moves keep bumping. I'll turn 10° left to pull that contact out of my path before driving.
The exit ray reads >8 at 350° to 0°, but a wall touches at about 5°. I'll turn 8° right to centre on the opening before driving.
The exit ray reads >8 straight ahead, and the right-side contact now reads about 2.4 m, so I'll try a short forward step.

The exit ray reads >8 straight ahead, but a wall touches my front-right at about 330°, which blocked the last forward move. Turning 10° left cleared that contact in an earlier scan, so I'll do that and then try a short step.
The exit opening (>8) is at roughly 345° to 0°, with a wall about 1.3 m away at 5°. I'll turn 10° right to centre on the gap before driving.
The exit reads open (>8) at roughly 355° to 10°, centred near 2°. I'll turn 3° left to centre on it, then try a short step.
The exit ray reads >8 at 355° and 0°, and the nearest walls are about 1.3 m off at 10°. I'll try a 1 m step straight toward the gap.
The exit reads open straight ahead, but every forward move has bumped at zero distance. I'll turn slightly right to check whether a narrower heading clears the frame, then try a short step.
The exit reads open (>8) at 0° to 10°, but the wall on my right touches at about 325°. I'll turn 8° left to centre the gap and then try a short step.

The exit reading (>8) is straight ahead at 0° to 5°, but the right side touches a wall and the left wall at 10° is about 1.3 m away, leaving a very narrow gap. I'll nudge left a few degrees to centre the robot in it.
The exit reading (>8) is now at about 345° to 0°, but a wall touches at 5°, so I'll turn about 8° right to centre the gap before driving.
The exit ray reads >8 straight ahead at 355° to 10°, so I'll try a short 0.5 m step through the gap.
The forward path is only blocked by a wall touching my front-right, with the left wall about 0.3 m off. I'll shift my body about 0.1 m to the left to clear that contact, then head forward.
The exit reading (>8) is now at about 265° to 280°, directly to my right. I'll turn right 90° to face it.

The exit ray is open straight ahead, but a wall touches my front-right at about 325°, which is why every forward move stops at zero. I'll turn left 90° and sidestep about 0.3 m away from that contact before heading forward again.
The exit ray (>8 m) is now off to my right at about 265° to 280°. I'll turn right to face it and then try a short step.

The exit ray reads >8 straight ahead, but a wall touches my front-right and has stopped every forward move. I'll back up 1 m to get clear of that contact, then try again on a slightly different heading.
The exit ray reads open (>8) straight ahead at 0° and 5°, and the wall on my right is now about 0.7 m away, so I'll drive forward 1.5 m toward the gap.
The exit ray reads open straight ahead, but my right side keeps touching a wall at about 320–325°, so I'll turn a few degrees left to pull away from it before driving.
The exit ray reads open at 345° to 0°, with a wall about 1.3 m away at 5°. I'll turn 5° right to centre on the gap before driving.

The exit ray at 0° reads open, but a wall at about 325° sits at zero distance and blocks every forward move. Left of me is open for about 2.8 m, so I'll turn left, sidestep a little, and then face the gap again.
The exit ray reads >8 at about 260° to 275°, to my right. I'll turn right 90° to face it.
The exit reads open (>8 m) straight ahead, but a close obstacle at about 325° has blocked every forward move. I'll shift my heading a few degrees left, away from that obstacle, and try again.
The exit ray reads open ahead, but my front-right keeps touching a wall, so I'll back up about 1 m to get clear and rescan.
The exit ray at 0° still reads open (>8), and the wall on my right has moved back to about 2 m after the reverse. I'll try a 1 m step straight toward the gap.
The exit ray at 0° reads open (>8), and the nearest obstacle is about 1.3 m away at 5°, so the gap is narrow but I'll drive straight ahead.
The exit ray at 0° still reads open, but my forward moves keep stopping at zero distance. The walls at 5° and 325° look close, so I'll turn right about 10° to try a different line through the gap.
Scans show the exit ray (>8) straight ahead, but a corner at about 20° and a wall at about 325–330° have blocked every forward move. I'll nudge the heading slightly left and try a short step.
The exit ray reads open straight ahead, but I keep bumping a wall at my front-right, so I'll try a short 0.5 m step.

The exit ray reads open straight ahead, but a wall at my front-right touches me at zero distance, so every forward move stops. Earlier I turned away from that wall without ever sidestepping, so this time I'll turn left 90°, step 0.4 m away from it, then turn back toward the gap.
The open exit reading (>8) is now about 90° to my right, at 265° to 280°. I'll turn right to face it.
The scan now shows open space straight ahead, between about 350° and 0°, and the right side is clear at about 2.3 m. I'll turn slightly right to centre on that gap before driving.
The exit ray reads open at 355° to 5°, and the nearest walls are about 1.3 m off on the left and 1.9 m on the right. I'll try a 1 m step straight ahead.
The exit ray reads open straight ahead, but a wall touching my front-right has blocked every forward move. I'll turn 45° left to clear that contact, then check the scan before moving.
The exit reading (>8) is at about 310° to 320°, to my front-right. I'll turn right 45° to face it.
The exit ray reads open straight ahead, but the right-front wall keeps touching me at zero distance. I'll turn left 90° and sidestep away from it before turning back toward the gap.
The exit reading (>8) is now to my right at about 265° to 280°. I'll turn right to face it and check the scan before driving.

The exit ray straight ahead reads open, but a wall corner at about 325° keeps touching my front-right. Earlier I turned left to sidestep but never actually moved, so this time I'll turn left 90° and really step sideways.
The robot has been looping near a narrow exit for many steps. The open space now is to my left, at about 3.5 to 4.5 m, so I'll turn toward it and probe forward.
The exit ray reads open (>8) directly behind me, at about 175° to 190°, and the way forward is walled. I'll back up 1 m toward that opening.
The scan shows open space (>8) at 175° to 190°, directly behind me, but my last reverse bumped at zero distance. I'll turn around so that opening faces forward, then check the scan before moving.

The exit ray reads open straight ahead, but a wall touching my front-right has blocked every forward move. Earlier I planned sidesteps and never executed them, so this time I'll turn left 90° and actually move sideways before turning back toward the gap.
The exit ray reads open (>8 m) at 265° to 280°, on my right. I'll turn right to face it and then test a short step.

I'm still boxed in at the exit: the open ray is straight ahead, but my front-right keeps touching a wall. Earlier sidestep plans never got executed. This time I'll turn left, actually move sideways, then turn back toward the gap.
The exit reading (>8) is off to my right again, so I'll turn right to face it and try the gap once more.
The exit ray still reads open straight ahead, but my right-front keeps touching a wall. I'll turn about 8° left to clear that corner before driving again.
The exit ray reads open (>8) at 345° to 0°, but a wall about 1.2 m away at 5° is squeezing the gap. I'll turn about 12° right to shift my heading away from that wall and then try a short move.
The exit ray (>8) is straight ahead, but a wall touches my front-right, so I'll try a short 0.5 m step to see whether the gap is passable.

The exit ray reads open straight ahead, but the forward moves keep bumping on something at my front-left (around 25–35°). I'll nudge my heading a few degrees right, away from that obstacle, and try a short step.
The scan shows open space (>8 m) straight ahead at 0° to 15°, with a wall close on my right. I'll drive forward 1 m toward the gap.
The exit ray reads open straight ahead, but a wall at my front-right keeps stopping forward moves. I'll turn right about 20° to move that contact out of my path, then check the scan before driving.
The exit (>8 m) now shows at 20° to 35° to my front-left, and the wall that kept blocking me is out of the way. I'll turn 25° left to face it.
The exit ray reads open straight ahead, but the right-front is touching a wall, which has blocked every forward move. I'll turn 15° left to pull away from that contact before trying a short step.
The exit ray (>8) is now at about 340° to 355°, to my front-right, while the wall ahead-left is about 1.2 m away. I'll turn right about 15° to point at the opening.
The exit ray reads open straight ahead, but my right-front keeps touching a wall at about 325–330°. I'll turn 12° left to move away from that contact, then try a short step.
The right-front contact that stopped my earlier moves now reads about 2.4 m, and the rays from 345° to 0° are open. I'll try a 1 m step straight ahead.

I'm at 152 of 200 actions. The exit ray straight ahead reads open, but my front-right keeps touching a wall. The area behind me is clear (about 4 m), so I'll back up 1 m to get free of the contact and then try a new heading.
The exit ray at 0° and 355° reads open again after backing up, so I'll try driving straight toward it.

The exit ray is open straight ahead, but I keep bumping, so the gap is probably narrower than my heading. I'll aim a bit further right, toward the middle of the open arc around 350°, and try a short step.
The exit ray reads open (>8) at 0° to 10°, but my last several forward moves bumped at zero distance on the right-front. I'll try a short step straight ahead.

The exit ray at 0° is open, but a wall corner at about 320° keeps touching my front-right, so every forward move stops at zero. I'll turn 40° left to move that contact out of my forward path, then try a short step.
The exit opening (>8 m) is now at about 315° to 330°, front-right. I'll turn 45° right to face it and check the scan before driving.

The exit ray reads open straight ahead, but the right side keeps touching a wall at zero distance. The open arc is roughly 0° to 15°, so I'll turn about 8° left to centre the robot in it before driving.
The forward gap reads open, but every forward move has stopped at zero distance on the front-right. I'll turn 20° left to pull the right-side contact out of my path, then try a short step.
The exit opening (>8 m) is now at about 330° to 345°, to my front-right, and the wall ahead is close. I'll turn right about 35° to face it.
The exit reading (>8) is now at 5° to 20°, slightly left of straight ahead, so I'll turn 12° left to centre on it.
The exit ray reads open straight ahead, but a wall touching my front-right has blocked every forward move. I'll turn left 90°, sidestep 0.4 m away from that contact, then turn back toward the gap.
The exit reads open (>8) at about 265° to 280°, on my right, after the last 90° left turn. I'll turn right to face it and check the scan before driving.
The exit gap is now centred around 355° (open at 350° to 5°, with walls at 10° and 345°), so I'll turn 5° right to line up on it.

The exit ray is open straight ahead, but a wall corner at about 330° sits at zero distance on my front-right, which blocks every forward move. Repeated turns haven't cleared it. I'll turn left about 85° so I can sidestep away from that corner, then turn back toward the gap.
The exit ray (>8 m) is now about 270° to 285°, on my right. I'll turn right about 83° to face it.

Forward rays 0° to 10° read open (>8 m), but the right side is touching a wall at about 300° to 330°. I'll back up 0.5 m to get clear of the right-side contact, then try the gap again from a slightly different position.
The exit ray at 0° and 5° reads open, and the wall on my right has moved back to about 0.4 m after backing up. I'll try a straight 1 m step toward the gap.
The exit ray reads open straight ahead, and the last forward move got 0.5 m before a bump on the right-front. I'll try a short step again.

The exit ray is open straight ahead, but a wall corner at about 330° touches my front-right and stops every forward move. Earlier I planned sidesteps and never executed them, so this time I'll turn left, actually move sideways, then turn back.
I've used 171 of 200 actions. The exit ray (>8 m) is now off to my right at about 265° to 280°, so I'll turn right 90° to face it and check the scan.

I'm at 172 of 200 actions. The exit reads open straight ahead, but a wall corner at about 330° sits against my front-right, so every forward move stops. Earlier sidestep plans only turned and never actually moved sideways. This time I'll turn left 90°, move 0.4 m to clear the corner, then turn back toward the exit.

The robot has been bumping at the same right-front corner for many steps. I just turned left, so forward now points away from that corner. I'll step 0.4 m forward to clear it, then turn back toward the exit.
The exit reading (>8 m) is about 95° to my right, at 255° to 265°. I'll turn right about 95° to face it.
The scan shows open space (>8 m) straight ahead at 350° to 0°, and the walls that blocked me earlier are now off to the side. I'll drive forward 2 m toward the exit.
The exit ray at 345° to 355° reads open, but something is touching my front-left, so I'll turn right about 10° to line up on the gap before driving.
The forward rays at 0° to 10° read open beyond the house, but something at 15° to 25° is touching my front-left. I'll try a short step straight ahead.
The exit ray is open straight ahead, but something at 15° to 25° is touching my front-left. I'll turn right 15° to move away from that contact before driving again.
The exit reads open (>8 m) at 10° to 25° to my left, and the wall at 30° to 40° is close. I'll turn 15° left to face the opening.
The exit ray at 0° to 10° reads open, but something at 15° is touching my front-left. I'll turn slightly right to line up with the open arc, then try a short step.

The exit ray is open straight ahead, but a wall corner at about 20° and a wall at 25° to 35° are touching my front-left. I'll turn 8° right to move my heading away from that corner before trying to drive forward.
The exit ray reads open at 10° to 20° on my left, and the wall at 25° is close. I'll turn 12° left to face the gap.
